sections.title: Case loader with loading and missing states
sections.what: Loads one case by its ID from the address. Shows a loading message while the case is fetched, a not-found message when the case does not exist, and the page content once it is loaded.
sections.why: Keeps the loading and missing-case handling in one place so every case page behaves the same way.
sections.watch_out: The line is cut off in the source, so the complete not-found and error handling cannot be checked here.

summary: Wrapper that loads one case by its ID from the web address and only shows the page content when the case is ready.
purpose: Handles the common loading, missing-case and ready states for the case pages, so each page does not repeat that logic.
why: Likely reason: several case pages need the same case lookup and the same loading behaviour. Reason not fully visible because the file is cut off.
how: Reads the case ID from the address, asks the case data hook for the case, shows a loading view while waiting, shows a not-found view when the case is missing, and otherwise passes the case details and ID to the child render function.
inputs: The case ID from the web address, the case data from the case context hook, and the translated text for the message strings.
outputs: A page area containing either a loading view, a not-found view, or the child content built from the case details.
risks: The code shown is cut off, so the error state and any other branches are not visible. A wrong case ID or a missing case shows the not-found view.
debug: If a case page stays on loading, check the case context hook and whether the case ID in the address is correct. If a page is blank, check the children function for an error in the case detail shape.
